positions.pos: Items go on glowing spots that fit them (hang, shelf, floor), not a free grid, to start. Tap an item in your satchel, then a spot; tap it again to put it back. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your words, 2026-10-23: "a lightweight room customizer". Spots keep it one tap on a phone and let the Cave of Lessons and Big Mind list their own spots. Still A on https://claude.ai/artifact/HwUN8nLCjbjpyBLv173yww.

positions.pos: The starter nook has a hearth, a window and five spots. Everything past that is earned through play (a lantern from your first kept agreement, a seed from a spirit you let go, a cushion when someone first sits with you, the mirror from orientation); nothing is bought. The four room styles become the light through the window. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your words, 2026-10-23: "an even more basic room people can use to update things and add items and assets they earn through play".

positions.pos: In a shared room either person may set an item down without asking, the way a room style works. Lifting the other person's item sends it back to their satchel, never away, and both show in While you were away. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Follows br-style-is-the-place (the place, not the Between). Things stay their owner's, like rc-spirits-visit.

positions.pos: One room kit for the Between, the Cave of Lessons and Big Mind: a room is a shell (its spots), a style and what sits on each spot, in a plain module beside room-styles.js. Today's Dusk hollow becomes the hollow shell with its pieces already placed, so nothing that works now changes. The kit is built after the part 3 build on bars-engine #428 lands. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: The coordinator's brief, 2026-10-23: make the customizer portable to Cave of Lessons and Big Mind.
